subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared cross-channel pending-group approval contract, and should pre-approval read-only observation be part of that contract or a separately opt-in mode?
rationale: The choice sets a persistent authorization boundary, determines whether untrusted group content may enter session state before approval, and cannot be safely inferred from existing DM pairing or per-channel allowlists.

options.title: Adopt staged core group pairing
options.body: Define shared pending-group approval and owner notification first, then add Telegram and WhatsApp adapters while keeping reader-agent observation out of the initial contract.

options.title: Adopt pairing plus observation
options.body: Design pending-group approval and a tightly restricted observation mode together, with explicit session, retention, and tool-policy guarantees.

options.title: Keep group handling allowlist-only
options.body: Retain current group admission controls and direct operators to channel allowlists plus plugins/hooks rather than adding a core pending-group workflow.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged core group pairing
recommendation.body: Define shared pending-group approval and owner notification first, then add Telegram and WhatsApp adapters while keeping reader-agent observation out of the initial contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest current-history routing candidate across the shared group-policy and channel access paths that would need the new contract.
